title: Delete Folder And Subtree in Document Manager
description: Answer: How do I delete folder and subtree? This is the canonical Document Manager workflow for delete-folder-and-subtree.

steps: Navigate to /files and open Document Manager.
Verify active workspace/company context before running delete folder and subtree.
Open the exact workflow action labeled for delete folder and subtree.
Enter required fields for delete folder and subtree (entity selection, date range, and status where applicable).
Apply changes and execute delete folder and subtree with explicit confirmation in the UI.
Validate selection scope before delete and confirm post-delete row count is reduced.
Validate result rows/totals/artifacts on the same page before navigating away.

Refresh session and confirm role permissions for general before retry.
